title: Custom errors in Box dyn Error
prompt: Why does returning a custom struct as Box<dyn `std::error::Error`> require implementing Display, and what error occurs if you omit it?
answer: The `std::error::Error` trait requires Display as a supertrait so the error can be formatted for users. Omitting Display causes E0277 because Box<dyn Error> cannot convert types that do not satisfy the Error trait bounds.
